concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-split-transactions-split-refunds]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace-path Checkout split-refund guide for explicit user/liable deductions, full-refund authorization-ratio and invalid-target liable fallbacks, and asynchronous per-split booking evidence; examples have inconsistent transfer/account IDs.
warnings: For a full refund without splits, the guide uses the authorization split rather than capture, with liable-account fallback if authorization lacked splits; it does not state the no-splits partial-refund allocation.

Raw 791–795 warns that format-only validation can leave a seemingly successful request fully booked to the liable account for a nonexistent or closed-holder target; sample fee/commission transaction identifiers differ from corresponding transfer examples.
